Footer.blurbZatours: I-ZAtours iwuhlu lwamabhizinisi ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika, eNingizimu nase-Mpumalanga ye-Afrika. Asithengisi izinkambo — ubhuka ngqo nebhizinisi elibhalisiwe.
Footer.r22Blurb: Route22 KwaZulu — umhlahlandlela womzila wezokuvakasha we-Elephant Coast, kusukela eSt Lucia kuya eKosi Bay.

Home.title: Thola indawo yokuhlala nokuthi wenzeni eNingizimu nase-Mpumalanga ye-Afrika.
Home.lead: Ama-lodge, izindlu zezivakashi, ama-safari, izinkambo nokuthuthwa — kubhaliswe ngamabhizinisi uqobo. Siqala eNingizimu Afrika futhi sikhula kuso sonke isifunda. Xhumana nabo ngqo; i-ZAtours iwuhlu, ayiyona inkampani yezinkambo.

Home.featuredLead: Abahlinzeki abakhethiwe — bheka uphawu oluthi <badge>Kuqinisekisiwe futhi kungabhukwa</badge> ukuze ubhuke ngqo.
Home.r22Body: I-Route22 ingumhlahlandlela wethu ohambisana nayo we-R22 — iHluhluwe-iMfolozi, iSt Lucia, iSodwana, iKosi Bay kanye nezindawo ezigodliwe zaseMaputaland, kanye namamephu, amapaki nezinhlelo zohambo.
Home.bizBody: Bhalisa mahhala, noma uthuthukise kusukela ku-{price}/ngenyanga ukuze uthole ikhasi eliphelele nemibuzo ize ngqo ku-imeyili yakho. Ayikho ikhomishini, nanini. Abasebenzisi be-OpDesk baboniswa njengabaqinisekisiwe futhi abangabhukwa.

hero.title: Shayela umgwaqo osendle kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika.
hero.lead: I-R22 iqonde enyakatho isuka ku-N2 eHluhluwe ize ifike emngceleni weMozambique — idlula ezindaweni ezigodliwe ze-Big Five, amaxhaphozi angamagugu omhlaba, izixhobo zokutshuza kanye nezicupho zezinhlanzi ezineminyaka engu-400 zaseMaputaland. I-Route22 ingumhlahlandlela wakho kuyo yonke indawo emgwaqweni.
hero.photoAlt: Indlovu iwela umgwaqo onetiyela endaweni egodliwe

intro.title: Umgwaqo owodwa. Zonke izizathu zokuza kwaZulu.
intro.body: Umzila we-Route22 ulandela i-R22 (umgwaqo waseLubombo) njengomgogodla wawo, uxhumanisa izingxenye ze-N2, i-P453 nomgwaqo oya eSt Lucia, uze uyofika eKosi Bay ubuye uye ePhongolo. Eduze kwawo kunezilwane eziningi, indawo yasendle nogu olude kunakho konke ezweni — kusukela epaki lezilwane elidala kunawo wonke e-Afrika kuya egugwini lokuqala lomhlaba laseNingizimu Afrika.

tours.title: Izinkambo nama-safari
tours.lead: Izinkampani zama-safari nezinkambo ezihlela uhambo losuku nolwezinsuku eziningi emzileni.
tours.example: Kuboniswa izibonelo zabahlinzeki — lapha kuzovela abalingani bezinkambo be-Route22 abaqinisekisiwe.

route.title: Umzila
route.lead: Thepha isitobhi ukuze ubone okukhona lapho. Lo mzila ushayelwa kahle ezinsukwini ezingu-4–7.

parks.title: Amapaki nezindawo ezigodliwe endleleni
parks.lead: Zonke izindawo ezinhle ze-Elephant Coast, kusukela eningizimu kuya enyakatho. Thepha ipaki ukuze uhlele ukuvakasha kwakho.

itins.title: Izibonelo zezinhlelo zohambo
itins.lead: Iziqalo ongazilungisa. Uma uqhubeka enyakatho, uhambo luba lude, lunensa futhi lube sendle kakhulu.

listings.title: Lapho ongahlala khona nokuthi wenzeni
listings.lead: Ama-lodge, amakamu, izindawo zokudlela nezinto ongazenza emzileni.
listings.example: Kuboniswa izibonelo — lapha kuzovela abalingani be-Route22 abaqinisekisiwe.
listings.community: Ukubhaliswa komphakathi kwamahhala — amabhizinisi asemzileni angakabi nekhasi eliphelele le-Route22.

more.title: Okunye okuvela ku-Route22
more.guidesD: Bhuka abaqondisi abazimele bama-safari, ukutshuza, ukubuka izinyoni, ukudoba namasiko, noma umshayeli wokuthutha.
more.industryD: Imihlahlandlela yokuhlela uhambo, amathiphu ezinkathi zonyaka, ulwazi ngokongiwa kwemvelo nezinsiza zabahlinzeki.
more.oppsD: Imisebenzi, ama-internship, ukuzinikela, ama-learnership namathenda emzileni.
more.lead: Ngaphezu komzila uqobo — abantu, izinsiza nokubhaliswa.

st-lucia.blurb: Isiqalo saseningizimu somzila emaphethelweni e-iSimangaliso. Izimvubu nezingwenya emlonyeni womfula, ukuhamba ngesikebhe kanye nomgwaqo oya eCape Vidal.

hluhluwe-imfolozi.blurb: Indawo yezilwane egodliwe esemthethweni endala kunazo zonke e-Afrika, futhi iyikhaya lokongiwa kobhejane. I-Big Five, ama-safari ozishayelayo nawaqondiswayo.

hluhluwe-town.blurb: Lapho umzila uhlangana khona ne-N2 bese i-R22 iqala ukuqonda enyakatho. Ama-lodge, izimpahla kanye nesiqalo sokuya ezindaweni ezigodliwe.

mkuze.blurb: Enye yezindawo ezinhle kakhulu zokubuka izinyoni e-Afrika, enezindawo zokucasha ezaziwayo, amahlathi omkhiwane namachibi agcwele izilwane.

sodwana.blurb: Ukutshuza okusezingeni lomhlaba ezixhotsheni zamakhorali eziseningizimu kakhulu, ukudoba olwandle olujulile kanye nengxenye yolwandle ye-iSimangaliso.

mbazwana.blurb: Idolobha elikhulu lezinsiza enyakatho ye-R22 — uphethiloli, izitolo kanye nempambanomgwaqo eya eSodwana naseChibini laseSibaya.

sibaya.blurb: Ichibi elikhulu kunawo wonke lamanzi ahlanzekile eNingizimu Afrika, elizungezwe yizindunduma ezinamahlathi — izimvubu, izingwenya nezinyoni eziningi.

rocktail.blurb: Amabhishi akude nezindawo lapho izimfudu zasolwandle zibekela khona — ezihlobo izimfudu ze-loggerhead ne-leatherback ziphuma ogwini.

tembe.blurb: Ikhaya lezindlovu ezinezinyo ezinkulu kakhulu e-Afrika, ehlathini lesihlabathi emngceleni weMozambique.

ndumo.blurb: Iphupho lababuki bezinyoni ethafeni lezikhukhula lomfula uPhongolo — izinhlobo ezingaphezu kuka-400 namachibi agcwele izilwane.

kosi-bay.blurb: Isiphetho esenyakatho eduze komngcele — amachibi axhumene, ukubhukuda nesibuko kanye nezicupho zezinhlanzi zendabuko ezineminyaka engu-400 ezisasetshenziswa.

pongola.blurb: Isango lasentshonalanga — idamu lasePongolapoort, ukudoba ama-tigerfish kanye nezindawo ezigodliwe ze-Big Five ngasezintabeni zeLubombo.

lake-sibaya.desc: Ichibi lemvelo elikhulu kunawo wonke lamanzi ahlanzekile eNingizimu Afrika — izimvubu, izingwenya nezinyoni eziningi.
